firstPlayerRule: There is no fixed first player. Each round, players secretly choose two ability cards, and figures then act in initiative order, starting with the lowest initiative.
officialTieBreak: If a character ties with a monster, the character goes first. If two characters tie, compare the initiative value of their second card.
clarifications: Of the two cards each player selects, one is chosen as the initiative card that sets the character's place in the round.
Initiative order is set again every round.

internalEvidence: Downloaded a copy of the Cephalofair Jaws of the Lion Learn-to-Play guide from the 1j1ju rulebook library (cephalofair.com links no JotL rules PDF; its Gloomhaven page links only the Gloomhaven second-edition rulebook) and extracted text from PDF pages 6, 7 and 31. Page 6: players privately and simultaneously select two cards, one as the initiative card. Page 7: arrange initiative tokens low to high; character-monster ties go to the character; character-character ties use the second card's initiative; the round starts with the lowest initiative. PDF page 31 credits Isaac Childres and Cephalofair Games, copyright 2020, matching BGG 291457. SHA-256: 5ece90b8054527a29ba56600d99a9b88c02fb567ee8334aac9bf9f70978f8fcb. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The cited PDF is a third-party-hosted copy of the publisher's guide, not a file on cephalofair.com.
This is a cooperative game; the guide describes per-round initiative, not a starting player.
